# Create PR for a project run: one linked PR per changed repo

## What to build
On an applied project run (a multi-repo suite in `<workspacesDir>/.projects/<id>/`), one **Create PR** button opens one PR (GitLab: MR) per repo that the apply changed, in `project.json` order (spec goal **MR-09**). For each such repo: create branch `gm/<runId>`; copy the project's `specs/<name>.md` to `docs/prd/done/<project>.md` and `contract.md` to `docs/prd/done/<project>-contract.md`; commit everything outside `.graph-execution/`; switch back to the original branch; push; open the PR with the title and body graph-manager uses today plus a `## Related PRs` section. Once every changed repo has its PR, each PR body is updated to link all the others. PRs are stored in the store's `prs` under `${projectId}/${runId}/${repo}`. When one repo fails, the panel shows that repo's error, and pressing the button again does only what is missing (opens the missing PRs, then the linking). The run page shows a PR panel with one row per repo: repo, PR link, state. Endpoints stay `GET/POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/pr`; for `:ws = project~<id>` they dispatch to a new `src/server/project-pr.ts`.

NOT in this task: single-repo Create PR (unchanged, `src/server/pr.ts`); moving anything in the project folder (its spec files stay where they are, the project folder is never pushed); starting or resuming project runs.

## What already exists (read, don't rebuild)
- `src/server/runhome.ts`: `PROJECT_PREFIX = "project~"`, `type RunHome = { kind: "workspace"; id; path; workspace } | { kind: "project"; id; path; project: Project }`, `resolveRunHome(workspacesDir, store, id)`, `homeAsWorkspace(home)`, `projectRepos(workspacesDir, home)` → `{ name, path, workspace?: Workspace }[]` in project.json order.
- `src/server/runs.ts`: `RunSummary.project?: { id, name, repos: string[] }`; `runDetail(home, runId, dataDir?)` works for a project home (a suite: `{ summary }` only); `summarize` sets `summary.pr` from `prs[\`${home.id}/${entry.id}\`]` (lines ~269–270).
- `src/server/projects.ts`: `Project { id; name; workspaces: string[]; createdAt }`, `projectDirOf`, `PROJECT_FILE`; store `projects` with `store.project(id)`. All workspaces of a project come from one forge (`forge` of the first workspace).
- `suite.json` (`suiteStateSchema` from `graph-execution/api`): `status` (`applied` when every repo was applied), `project?: { dir, name, contract }`, `repos?: { name, path, startingCommit, startBranch?, applied?: { files, conflicts } }[]`.
- The web: `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` shows a project run's static suite card (with `data-testid="run-project-repos"`) but no PR panel; `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` shows `Create PR` for any applied run without `pr` (`isReady`, line 25) and navigates to `<runPath>#pr`.

## Context: files to read before implementing
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` (all, 338 lines): `PrError`, `PATHSPEC`/`RUNS_FOLDER` (82–84), `git()` (89–92), `scrub`/`lastLine` (94–105), `specTitle`/`suggest` (107–135: title from the spec's first `# `, body = task list + `Generated by graph-execution run <id>.`, base = target branch → current branch → forge default → `main`), `prStatus` (153–169), `preparePr` (184–201: branch-name check, existing branch → 409), `runPrJob` (216–291: the steps, identity fallback at 259–261, push with `gitAuthArgs` and `pushProgress` at 264–269, switch back at 272, store write at 278–280), the job registry (293–338).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.ts` (all, 42 lines).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.ts` (26–33 `ForgeClient`; 143–196 GitHub/GitLab clients; 208–223 `connFor`/`clientFor`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (19–25 `prs` schema).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/specdone.ts` (all) — the single-repo spec move, for the path handling style (realpath, `/` in git paths).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (243–277 `summarize`, the `pr` lookup at 269–270).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PrPanel.tsx` (all, 342 lines: `PrSteps`, `PrSection`, `PrPanel`), `src/web/pages/PrPanel.css`, `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` (412–440: the suite body and where `PrPanel` sits for runs), `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (114–141 `ActionCell`).
- `apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs` (136–208: pulls recorded, GitHub `POST /repos/:o/:r/pulls`, GitLab `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests`) and `scripts/fake-forge.d.mts`.
- Tests: `src/server/routes/pr.test.ts` (all: `connect`, `cloneWithRun`, `waitForJob`, `bareOf`, the push-failure case at ~245–259), `src/server/forges.test.ts`, `src/web/pages/PrPanel.test.tsx`.

## Patterns to follow
Commit/push steps of a single PR (pr.ts:249–272), reused per repo:
```ts
await run(["add", "-A", "--", "."]);
await run(["reset", "-q", "--", RUNS_FOLDER]);
const email = await git(ws, ["config", "user.email"]);
const identity = email.stdout === "" ? ["-c", "user.name=graph-manager", "-c", "user.email=graph-manager@localhost"] : [];
await run([...identity, "commit", "-m", title, "-m", body]);
await run([...gitAuthArgs(forge, token), "push", "--progress", "-u", "origin", branch], onProgress);
```
Errors never carry the token: `scrub(text, token)` on every detail and error.

## Step-by-step tasks
### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `ForgeClient.updatePullRequest(p: { fullPath: string; number: number; body: string }): Promise<void>` — GitHub `PATCH /repos/${githubRepoPath(fullPath)}/pulls/${number}` `{ body }`; GitLab `GET /projects/:path` for the id, then `PUT /projects/${id}/merge_requests/${number}` `{ description: body }`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/forges.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs` (+ `.d.mts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: record a `number` on each pull (per forge, as `recordPull` counts today) and handle GitHub `PATCH /repos/:o/:r/pulls/:n` and GitLab `PUT /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid` by replacing that pull's `body` (404 when unknown). Add `number: number` to `FakePull`.
- **GOTCHA**: existing tests compare `forge.pulls` with `expect.objectContaining`, so an extra field is safe.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the `prs` record gains `linked: z.boolean().optional()` (true once the PR body lists all the project's other PRs). Document the key forms: `${workspaceId}/${runId}` and `${projectId}/${runId}/${repo}`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/project-pr.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `prKeyOf(projectId, runId, repo) = \`${projectId}/${runId}/${repo}\`` (projectId is the bare id, e.g. `billing`, not `project~billing`).
  - `interface ProjectPrRepo { name: string; workspaceId?: string; fullPath?: string; changed: boolean; pr?: { url; number; branch; base? }; linked?: boolean; error?: string }` and `interface ProjectPrStatus { project: true; eligible: boolean; reason?: string; repos: ProjectPrRepo[]; job?: ProjectPrJob }`.
  - `projectPrStatus(ctx, home, runId)`: undefined when the suite does not exist (`runDetail(home, runId)`); `eligible: false` with reason `the run has not landed (status <s>)` unless suite status is `applied`; `<Forge> is not connected` when `connFor(ctx, forge)` is missing; for each repo of `projectRepos(...)`: `pr` from the store; `changed` = no stored PR and (`git status --porcelain -- . :(exclude).graph-execution` is non-empty, or local branch `gm/<runId>` exists — a repo whose earlier attempt committed but did not open the PR). `eligible` when some repo is `changed`, or every stored PR exists but one is not `linked`; reason `no repo has changes to open a PR from` when nothing is changed and no PR exists; `all pull requests are open` when everything is done.
  - `ProjectPrJob = { id; status: "running" | "done" | "failed"; startedAt; repos: { name: string; status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "failed" | "skipped"; steps: PrJobStep[]; error?: string; pr?: { url; number; branch } }[]; link: { state: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "failed"; detail?: string } }` (reuse `PrJobStep`/`PrStep` from pr.ts, export what you need).
  - `startProjectPr(ctx, home, runId)`: the same registry/`starting` guard as `startPr` (pr.ts:316–338; key `${projectId}/${runId}`); 409 when not eligible; then runs in the background, repo by repo in project.json order, never throwing:
    1. A changed repo with uncommitted changes and no `gm/<runId>` branch: `checkout -b gm/<runId>` (branch name validated with `check-ref-format --branch` as pr.ts:194–195); write `docs/prd/done/<project>.md` from `<projectDir>/specs/<name>.md` (skip when the repo has no spec) and `docs/prd/done/<project>-contract.md` from `<projectDir>/contract.md` (`mkdir -p`, overwrite); `add`/`reset`/`commit` as above; then **always** `checkout --quiet <original>` (from `symbolic-ref --short HEAD` before step 1) once the commit is made, also when a later step fails. `<project>` = `suite.json.project.name` ?? project.json `name` ?? the project id.
    2. A repo with the `gm/<runId>` branch already there and a clean tree: skip checkout/commit (steps `done` with detail `already committed`).
    3. A repo with both uncommitted changes and an existing `gm/<runId>` branch: that repo fails with `branch gm/<runId> already exists`.
    4. Push (`gitAuthArgs`, `pushProgress`), then `createPullRequest({ fullPath, head: "gm/<runId>", base, title, body })`; store `prs[prKeyOf(...)] = { url, number, branch, base, forge, createdAt }`.
    A failing repo does not stop the others. Title = the first `# ` heading of `<projectDir>/specs/<name>.md`, else `<project>: graph-execution suite <runId>`. Base = that repo's `suite.json.repos[i].startBranch` → its current branch → forge default branch → `main`. Body = `- [x] <id> <title>` per task file in `<projectDir>/tasks/<name>/*.json` (not `test-plan.json`, `taskTitle` from runs.ts), a blank line, `Generated by graph-execution suite <runId> (project <project>).`, then the related section.
  - `relatedSection(self, others)`: `## Related PRs` then one line per other repo of the project that is or will be in a PR: `- <fullPath>#<number> <url>` when known, `- <fullPath> (opened with this one)` before it is. Initial bodies use what is known at creation; after the loop, if every changed repo of the run now has a stored PR, set `link.state = "running"`, call `updatePullRequest` for each PR with its rebuilt body (same deterministic builder, now with every number) and set `linked: true` in the store; a failure leaves `linked` unset and fails the `link` step (a later press retries only the linking).
  - The job status: `done` when every repo is `done`/`skipped` and `link` is `done` (or there is a single PR: nothing to link, `link.state = "done"`), else `failed` with `error` naming the repos (`web: push failed: …`).
- **GOTCHA**: paths: `path.join` for files, `/` for git pathspecs (`docs/prd/done/<project>.md`); the copied files must exist before `git add -A` so they land in the same commit. Unchanged repos (no changes, no PR) get status `skipped` and no branch.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: resolve `:ws` with `resolveRunHome`; for a project: `GET` → `projectPrStatus` (+ `job: currentProjectJob(...)` when any), 404 `unknown run`; `POST` → `startProjectPr` (body ignored; 202 `{ job }`; `PrError` → its status). Workspace homes keep `prStatus`/`startPr` exactly as today.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/pr.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `summarize`, for a project home, `summary.pr` = the stored PR of the first repo of `summary.project.repos` that has one under `${projectId}/${entry.id}/${repo}` (so the Runs list shows the PR link instead of "Create PR" once PRs exist).

### UPDATE web: `src/web/pages/PrPanel.tsx`, `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `ProjectPrSection({ ws, runId, status })` in PrPanel.tsx: GETs the status (poll every `PR_POLL_MS` while the job runs, as `PrSection`), renders a table `data-testid="pr-project-repos"` with one row per repo `data-testid="pr-repo-<name>"`: repo (`fullPath`), the PR link (`PR #n ↗` / `MR !n ↗`) or the job's state for that repo (`PrSteps` of that repo while running), and the repo's error (`data-testid="pr-repo-error-<name>"`). One button `data-testid="pr-submit"` (`Create PRs` / `Create MRs`, `Retry` when the last job failed) enabled when `eligible`; the reason when not (`data-testid="pr-reason"`). `PrPanel` takes `project?: boolean` and renders `ProjectPrSection` then; the forge chip comes from the response's repos (first workspace id's forge). RunDetail renders `<aside className="run-detail-side"><PrPanel … project /></aside>` next to the static suite card when `summary.project` is set (so `#pr` from the Runs list lands on it).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/pages/PrPanel.test.tsx src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx`

### Tests to add
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/project-pr.test.ts` (copy the setup of `routes/pr.test.ts`: fake forge, `connect("github")`, clones through `POST /api/workspaces` of `acme/api` and `acme/web` after `forge.addRepo(...)` if the fake needs it). Then build the project by hand: `<workspacesDir>/.projects/billing` with `git init`, `project.json` (`api` → `repos/api`, `web` → `repos/web`), links via `symlink(target, link, process.platform === "win32" ? "junction" : "dir")`, `contract.md`, `specs/api.md` (`# Billing API`), `specs/web.md`, `tasks/api/1.json` (`{ id: "1", content: "# Add endpoint", dependencies: [] }`), the store's `projects.billing = { name: "billing", workspaces: ["github~acme~api", "github~acme~web"], createdAt }`, and `.graph-execution/suite-20261113-120000-abcd/suite.json` parsed with `suiteStateSchema` (status `applied`, two features with `repo`, `project: { dir, name: "billing", contract }`, `repos` with `startBranch: "main"`). Write `hello.txt` in both workspaces. Cases:
  1. `GET /api/runs/project~billing/<id>/pr` → `eligible: true`, both repos `changed: true`. POST → 202; wait for the job: both repos `done`, `link.state === "done"`; `forge.pulls` has two pulls with `head: "gm/suite-20261113-120000-abcd"`; the api PR's final body contains `## Related PRs` and `acme/web#<n>` and the web PR's contains `acme/api#<n>`; `git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/heads/gm/<id>` in each bare repo lists `hello.txt`, `docs/prd/done/billing-contract.md`, and for api also `docs/prd/done/billing.md`, and never `.graph-execution`; both workspaces are back on `main`; `store.get().prs` has `billing/<id>/api` and `billing/<id>/web` with `linked: true`; a second GET answers `eligible: false`, `reason: "all pull requests are open"`; the Runs list summary of the run has `pr`.
  2. Only one repo changed (no `hello.txt` in web): one PR, web `skipped`, nothing to link, job `done`.
  3. Retry: remove the `acme/web` bare repo (`bareOf`) before POST → api `done`, web `failed` at push with a scrubbed error, `link` not done, job `failed`, web back on `main` with branch `gm/<id>` kept; recreate it with `forge.addRepo("acme/web", "github")`, POST again → only web is pushed and opened (`forge.pulls` grows by one, api is `skipped`/already open), then both bodies are linked.
  4. Not applied (`status: "failed"`) → POST 409 `the run has not landed (status failed)`; GitHub disconnected → reason `GitHub is not connected`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.test.ts`: `updatePullRequest` on GitHub and GitLab against the fake forge.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PrPanel.test.tsx`: `PrPanel project` renders a row per repo with the PR link of the open one, the error of the failed one, and the `Retry` button.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One press opens one PR per changed repo; each commit adds `docs/prd/done/<project>.md` (when the repo has a spec) and `docs/prd/done/<project>-contract.md`; each final PR body links the others under `## Related PRs`.
- [ ] PRs are stored under `${projectId}/${runId}/${repo}`; a second press after a failure in one repo opens only that repo's PR, then links all of them.
- [ ] Every repo is back on its original branch after its commit, whatever failed later; no error or stored record contains the token.
- [ ] Single-repo Create PR behaves exactly as before (`routes/pr.test.ts` passes unchanged).
- [ ] The run page of an applied project run shows one row per repo with repo, PR link and state.

## Validation commands
```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/project-pr.test.ts src/server/routes/pr.test.ts src/server/forges.test.ts src/server/runs.test.ts
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/pages/PrPanel.test.tsx src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx
```
